summary: Dashboard Staff page redesign (Workshop 02): plain labels (Operator shown as Sales rep), store access and invite expiry on rows, Change access and Suspend as member-sheet views, and a new web action that removes people who never joined (pending or suspended unaccepted invites).
noAssistantImpact: No assistant tool, capability, procedure or permission changes. The assistant keeps its existing staff invitation INVITE/RESEND/REVOKE, status and access commands. Removing someone who never joined is web-only for now (excluded from the assistant): it is a POST /api/staff remove operation under the same staff-management authority and tenant lock as status changes, with an explicit alert confirmation in the dashboard. Assistant support can be planned later as a reviewed command.

docs.note: No schema change; uses the existing REMOVED membership status and REMOVED lifecycle event.

evidence.result: 15 pass, including removal allowed for pending/suspended unaccepted and refused for joined staff, owners/admins and self.
